scenicChapters.title: Mölln lake stop → Ratzeburg island coffee
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 11 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Baltic Coast Scenic Road
